paragraphs: It is a hot Saturday, so Ben and I go to the pond. Ben is tall, and I am a little shorter. Ben wears a blue T-shirt, blue jeans, and gray sneakers. I wear a red T-shirt, blue shorts, and blue sneakers. Ben has a big yellow bag on his back. We both want to see the green frogs. "Be careful, Sam," says Ben. "The grass is wet."

I see a big frog and run to it. Splash! I fall into the pond. My red T-shirt, my blue shorts, and my sneakers are all wet. The water is cold on my stomach. The frog jumps away into the grass. Ben laughs, and then he stops. "Are you OK, Sam?" he asks. "Yes, but I only have these clothes," I say.

"Don't worry," says Ben. "I have dry clothes in my bag." He gives me a yellow T-shirt and gray shorts. I change behind a tree. Ben's T-shirt is big, and his shorts are very long. Ben looks at me and laughs again. "You look funny in my clothes!" he says. I laugh, too. I invite Ben to my house for lunch because he is a good friend. We walk home with my wet clothes in the yellow bag. What do you wear when you play by the water? What do you have in your bag?
text.summary: Sam goes to the pond with Ben on a hot day. Sam falls in, and Ben gives him dry clothes that are too big.
